item.title: Americans report stable personal well being but declining national confidence
item.description: American reports of individual well-being have remained relatively stable over decades, but confidence in the nation has sharply declined. James N. Druckman and colleagues analyzed long-term survey data from two National Science Foundation-supported infrastructure projects: the General Social Survey and the American National Election Studies.

item.title: Measuring AI acceptance among Japanese medical students and rresident physicians
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming healthcare and medical education. From enhancing diagnostic accuracy and clinical decision-making to enabling virtual simulations and personalized learning, AI technologies are becoming embedded in the daily practice of clinicians and trainees.

item.title: New Pico C technology maps genome structure before activation
item.description: For decades, scientists viewed the genome of a newly fertilised egg as a structural 'blank slate' – a disordered tangle of DNA waiting for the embryo to 'wake up' and start reading its own genetic instructions.

item.title: Metabolite-driven AI model accurately estimates time of death
item.description: Artificial intelligence can be used to provide a more precise time of death, which can be crucial in e.g. murder investigations.

item.title: Barshop Institute at UT Health San Antonio secures major federal funding for longevity trial
item.description: Positioning The University of Texas at San Antonio as a national anchor for aging and longevity science, its Sam and Ann Barshop Institute for Longevity and Aging Studies will receive up to $38 million in federal funding for the first nationwide clinical study in healthy longevity.

item.title: Nutri-Score labeling system fails to reflect nutritional complexity of cocoa
item.description: Researchers at the University of Granada have revealed that the Nutri-Score labeling system, commonly used in Europe to assess food quality, is unable to adequately reflect the nutritional and metabolic complexity of soluble cocoa sold in Spain.

item.title: INTEGRA Biosciences strengthened its market position in 2025
item.description: INTEGRA Biosciences reported a successful financial year in 2025, despite exceptional economic and geopolitical challenges.

item.title: SolasCure completes Phase II clinical trial, demonstrating accelerated healing with Aurase Wound Gel
item.description: SOLASCURE Ltd (SolasCure), a biotechnology company developing a novel treatment to transform chronic wound healing, today announced the successful completion of its second Phase II clinical trial, CLEANVLU2. The study demonstrated that its investigational product, Aurase Wound Gel (AWG), heals chronic wounds at a faster rate than current standard of care, providing clinical validation of its ability to deliver continuous enzymatic debridement while simultaneously activating wound healing.

item.title: Lingering brain inflammation found after mild COVID infection
item.description: Even a mild case of COVID-19 or the flu can impact the body long after the fever and cough fade, according to new Tulane University research that may help explain why some people struggle to feel fully recovered weeks or months later.

item.title: High-risk patients account for majority of postoperative deaths and readmissions
item.description: A major new study, led by Queen Mary University of London and funded by the National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR) has been published in The Lancet Public Health.
